content:
The party has officially begun. Best Buy’s Black Friday 2026 sale is now live, running November 19 - 30. It features deals on all sorts of things, ranging from TVs and Apple products to video games and gaming PCs. If you can buy it at Best Buy, it’s probably on sale. Let’s take a look at our picks for the best deals available.

Shop the Full Sale

You can skip right on over to the full sale at the link above, or you can keep reading to find our picks, as well as links to the sale items by category.

Video Game Deals

There’s no better time in all the year to buy video games than Black Friday. This is generally when we get the first halfway decent discounts on all the year’s new releases, and deep discounts on older games. Right now you can get all-time low prices on games like Resident Evil Requiem and The Blood of Dawnwalker, as well as LEGO Horizon Adventures for $9.99.

TV Deals

TVs are some of the most popular big-ticket items during Black Friday, and it’s easy to see why. We’re seeing discounts on all of the best gaming TVs, whether you need a new one for your PS5 Pro or you want a giant 98” TV at a (relatively) budget price.

PC Deals

Gaming PCs are getting more and more expensive these days, so if you’re going to buy one, you should absolutely do it while they’re on sale. Thankfully, right now Best Buy has a whole lot of pre-built gaming PCs on sale for as cheap as you’ll find them anywhere. Also on sale are things like monitors, mice, and budget-friendly laptops.

LEGO Deals

LEGO sets don’t go on sale as often as many other categories do. And when they do, the deals are often not all that spectacular – except during Black Friday. If you want to stock up on LEGO sets as gifts or for yourself, now’s a good time to do it. Look for sets that are over 20% off for the best LEGO deals.

Apple Deals

Everyone loves Apple products, but not everyone loves their prices. Right now you can save cash on everything from AirPods Pro 3 and MacBook Air, to Apple Watch and iPad. I’ve been following Apple for over a decade now, and I can assure you there’s no better time of the year to buy these products than Black Friday.

The Black Friday sales have now kicked off in earnest, with Best Buy, Amazon, PlayStation, and Xbox sales going live. As always, I expect more deals to come online as we inch closer to actual Black Friday (November 27), so keep checking back to see what’s worth picking up during this holiday shopping season.
